scope: Curved frame is validated against an analytic fixed-guided beam. Common centerline leaf approximation retains a2x force acceptance allocation.
Cold terminal supports are mandatory. Their rigidity must be at least the hot PCB terminal rigidity; credited hot inertial reactions require this load path.
All200 leaves remain free in the flex region. Bonding or solder wicking into the span invalidates the low stiffness.
Elastic static deflection/load screen does not prove fatigue, creep, solder life or supplier force/adhesive acceptance.
2mm axial displacement and30g transverse sensitivity are separate declared bounds; arbitrary simultaneous multiaxis shock is not covered.
